metadata.title: Schematic Lithostratigraphic Map of India - Archean Basement and Precambrian Supergroups
metadata.accuracy_disclaimer: GEOMETRY IS SCHEMATIC/APPROXIMATE. Polygons are illustrative extents derived from published basin/craton descriptions, NOT digitized from official GSI survey maps. Do not use for precise spatial analysis, land-use, or engineering decisions. Suitable for general public education and conceptual visualization only.
metadata.age_reference: Numeric age ranges (age_min_ma = older bound, age_max_ma = younger bound, both in millions of years before present) follow standard geologic timescale usage (ICS International Chronostratigraphic Chart) combined with basin-specific literature ages. Ranges for Vindhyan, Bhima, and Chhattisgarh Supergroups remain actively debated among researchers - see age_uncertain flag.
metadata.recommended_use: Time-slider filtering: show a feature when slider_value is between age_min_ma and age_max_ma. Pair with a real basemap (e.g. OneGeology WMS) for visual context.

properties.name: Peninsular Gneissic Complex (Dharwar Craton basement)
properties.note: Age corrected to ~3000 Ma per Ramakrishnan, Table 3D-2. EDC equivalent: 'Enclaves of older gneiss', same age.
properties.source: Ramakrishnan, M. - Table 3D-2, Simplified stratigraphy of Archaean Dharwar craton

properties.name: Sargur Group
properties.rank_note: Positioned below the Dharwar Supergroup's basal unconformity, i.e. older basement rather than part of the Supergroup - moved out of Dharwar Supergroup per Table 3D-2
properties.note: Eastern Dharwar Craton equivalents (tentative): (?) Warangal Group, (?) Salem Group, same age range.
properties.source: Ramakrishnan, M. - Table 3D-2, Simplified stratigraphy of Archaean Dharwar craton

properties.name: Gorur Gneiss
properties.note: Oldest dated basement unit in the Dharwar craton per Table 3D-2. EDC equivalent: 'Putative Basement', same age range.
properties.source: Ramakrishnan, M. - Table 3D-2, Simplified stratigraphy of Archaean Dharwar craton

properties.name: Bastar Gneissic Complex
properties.note: Oldest basement of the Bastar craton, with relict signatures at 3600-3500 Ma; bulk of the gneiss dated at >3000 Ma per Table 3B-1. Range narrowed and flagged uncertain since relict ages are only 'vestiges', not the dominant crystallization age.
properties.source: Ramakrishnan, M. - Table 3B-1, Generalised stratigraphy of Bastar craton

properties.name: Sukma Group / Amgaon Group
properties.note: Amgaon Group in the Kotri-Dongargarh Orogen; Sukma Group is the equivalent unit across the rest of the craton
properties.source: Ramakrishnan, M. - Table 3B-1, Generalised stratigraphy of Bastar craton

properties.name: Bhopalpatnam and Kondagaon granulites, Sukma granites
properties.region: Bastar craton, Chhattisgarh (rest of craton, not present in Kotri-Dongargarh Orogen sector)
properties.source: Ramakrishnan, M. - Table 3B-1, Generalised stratigraphy of Bastar craton

properties.name: Bengpal Group
properties.region: Bastar craton, Chhattisgarh (present in both the Kotri-Dongargarh Orogen and rest of the craton)
properties.source: Ramakrishnan, M. - Table 3B-1, Generalised stratigraphy of Bastar craton

properties.name: Bailadila Group
properties.note: Named for the Bailadila iron-ore range
properties.source: Ramakrishnan, M. - Table 3B-1, Generalised stratigraphy of Bastar craton

properties.name: Nandgaon Group / Sonakhan Group
properties.note: Nandgaon Group in the Kotri-Dongargarh Orogen; Sonakhan Group is the equivalent unit across the rest of the craton
properties.source: Ramakrishnan, M. - Table 3B-1, Generalised stratigraphy of Bastar craton

properties.name: Dongargarh Granite / Malanjkhand Granite / Kanker Granite
properties.note: Dongargarh Granite in the Kotri-Dongargarh Orogen; Malanjkhand and Kanker Granites are equivalent intrusions across the rest of the craton
properties.source: Ramakrishnan, M. - Table 3B-1, Generalised stratigraphy of Bastar craton

properties.name: Khairagarh Group
properties.source: Ramakrishnan, M. - Table 3B-1, Generalised stratigraphy of Bastar craton

properties.name: Chilpi Group / Sakoli Group
properties.note: Chilpi Group in the Kotri-Dongargarh Orogen; Sakoli Group is the equivalent unit across the rest of the craton. Youngest unit in Table 3B-1.
properties.source: Ramakrishnan, M. - Table 3B-1, Generalised stratigraphy of Bastar craton

properties.name: Singhbhum Craton (Older Metamorphic Group / Singhbhum Granite)
Chhotanagpur Granite Gneissic Complex (CGGC)
properties.note: CGGC is polyphase/reworked; age range shown reflects dominant granulite-facies events, not a single simple crystallization age

properties.name: Banded Gneissic Complex (BGC) / Bhilwara Supergroup basement
Dharwar Supergroup
properties.note: Age and group membership corrected per Ramakrishnan, Table 3D-2: Sargur Group lies below the basal unconformity as older basement, not part of the Supergroup proper. Eastern Dharwar Craton equivalents are the Kolar Group and Yashwantanagar Formation (also 2800-2600 Ma).
properties.source: Ramakrishnan, M. - Table 3D-2, Simplified stratigraphy of Archaean Dharwar craton

properties.name: Mahakoshal Supergroup
properties.rank_note: Conventionally ranked as Mahakoshal Group, not Supergroup
properties.region: Son Valley / Central Indian Tectonic Zone, MP-UP border

properties.name: Vindhyan Supergroup
properties.note: Age of upper Vindhyan remains actively debated (some workers argue for a much older, entirely Proterozoic age with no Cambrian overlap)

properties.name: Bhima Supergroup
properties.rank_note: Conventionally ranked as Bhima Group - smallest Proterozoic basin in India

properties.name: Kurnool Supergroup
properties.rank_note: Conventionally ranked as Kurnool Group, unconformably overlying Cuddapah Supergroup
properties.region: Kurnool Basin, Andhra Pradesh (northern part of Cuddapah Basin)
